description: React component for displaying product notices in a modal dialog within the Mattermost web application, including fetching notices, navigation, and rendering UI elements.

classes.name: ProductNoticesModal
classes.description: React component class managing the display and interaction of product notices in a modal.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches notices data when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Fetches notices data when socket connection status changes or team ID is set.

methods.name: fetchNoticesData
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notices data based on current team and client type.

methods.name: confirmButtonText
methods.description: Returns the appropriate confirm button label based on current notice.

methods.name: cancelButtonText
methods.description: Returns the label for the cancel button if applicable.

methods.name: renderCicrleIndicators
methods.description: Renders navigation circle indicators for notices.

methods.name: renderAdminOnlyText
methods.description: Displays admin-only notice indicator if applicable.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image if present in the notice.

methods.name: renderActionButton
methods.description: Renders an action button if specified in the notice.

methods.name: handleNextButton
methods.description: Handles advancing to the next notice or opening a link if only one notice.

methods.name: handlePreviousButton
methods.description: Handles navigating to the previous notice.

methods.name: onModalDismiss
methods.description: Resets notices data when modal is dismissed.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with notices content and controls.
